1970s into the 1980s. The largest Hmong community in , he United States is 
centered in Minneapolis-St. Paul. Most Hmong were originally subsistence 
farmers. In the United States, relatively few owned farms, typically for want 
of capital, though many worked in agriculture-related 
jobs.
